title: The Watering Can for the Window Boxes
youtube_title: The Watering Can for the Window Boxes | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small useful favor can be louder than a big speech.
summary: At a market lane of baskets, jars, and flower pots, a watering can meant for the high window boxes is awkward for one person. Golda notices Grandma Nia struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
